note: Illustrative starter library in the Parashari tradition. Every rule, and the Nepali and Japanese labels, should be reviewed by a qualified astrologer and native speakers before production use.

rules.name: Gaja Kesari Yoga

label.ja: 知恵と周囲からの支え

rules.reading: Jupiter in a kendra from the Moon: good judgement, respect from others and support during difficulties.

rules.name: Strong Lagna lord

label.ja: 強い自己意識

rules.reading: The Lagna lord sits in a kendra or trikona: a resilient sense of self and the ability to steer one's own life.

rules.name: Bhagya lord well placed

label.en: Luck that comes through effort and mentors
label.ja: 努力と師から開ける運

rules.reading: The 9th lord is well placed: fortune, mentors and opportunities tend to arrive through effort and guidance.

rules.name: Lagna lord in a dusthana

label.ja: エネルギーを大切に守る時

rules.reading: The Lagna lord sits in the 6th, 8th or 12th: life asks for care with energy and boundaries; rest and routine help you stay steady.

rules.name: 10th lord in kendra or trikona

label.en: A career set to grow steadily
label.ja: 着実に伸びるキャリア

rules.reading: The 10th lord is in a kendra or trikona: a career that can grow steadily and bring recognition.

rules.name: Sun in the 10th house

label.ja: 仕事での自然なリーダーシップ

rules.reading: The Sun has directional strength in the 10th: leadership, visibility and comfort with authority.

rules.name: Saturn in the 10th house

label.ja: ゆっくりでも長続きするキャリア

rules.reading: Saturn in the 10th: a slower but durable career built on discipline and responsibility.

rules.name: Mercury in Lagna or 10th

label.ja: コミュニケーションと技術の強み

rules.reading: Mercury in the 1st or 10th: strength in communication, analysis, trade and technology work.

rules.name: Rahu in an upachaya house

label.ja: 時とともに育つ向上心

rules.reading: Rahu in an upachaya house: ambition that grows with time and openness to unconventional or foreign paths.

rules.name: 10th lord in a dusthana

label.ja: 粘り強さが必要なキャリアの進展

rules.reading: The 10th lord sits in the 6th, 8th or 12th: career progress tends to come through service, research or behind-the-scenes work, and needs persistence.

rules.name: 7th lord well placed

label.ja: パートナーシップに恵まれる

rules.reading: The 7th lord is well placed: partnerships are supported and a committed relationship can bring growth.

rules.name: 7th lord in a dusthana

label.ja: 忍耐が必要な人間関係

rules.reading: The 7th lord is in the 6th, 8th or 12th: partnerships may need extra patience, clear communication and time.

rules.name: Venus dignified

label.ja: 愛情における温かさと調和

rules.reading: Venus is exalted or in its own sign: warmth, artistic taste and harmony in relationships.

rules.name: Mangal placement (Manglik check)

label.ja: マンガリク確認（よくあり、打ち消されることが多い）

rules.reading: Mars is in a house traditionally checked for Manglik status. This is common, often cancelled by other factors, and should be assessed in matching, not feared.

rules.name: Jupiter in the 7th house

label.ja: 賢く支えになるパートナー

rules.reading: Jupiter in the 7th: a wise, supportive partner and partnerships grounded in shared values.

rules.name: Venus debilitated

label.ja: 理解とともに深まる愛

rules.reading: Venus is debilitated: affection may be expressed through practical care rather than words; patience and understanding help love grow.

rules.name: Dhana Yoga (2nd and 11th lords)

label.ja: 貯蓄と収入が支え合う

rules.reading: The 2nd lord sits in the 11th: savings and income support each other when managed well.

rules.name: 11th lord in the 2nd

label.ja: 利益が蓄えに変わる

rules.reading: The 11th lord sits in the 2nd: gains tend to turn into accumulated resources.

rules.name: Jupiter in 2nd or 11th

label.ja: 知識による成長

rules.reading: Jupiter in the 2nd or 11th: growth in resources through knowledge, teaching or good advice.

rules.name: 11th lord in the 12th

label.ja: 支出が収入を上回りやすい

rules.reading: The 11th lord sits in the 12th: gains can flow out as quickly as they come in; a budget and savings habit protect what you earn.

rules.name: 5th lord in kendra or trikona

label.ja: 鋭く創造的な頭脳

rules.reading: The 5th lord is well placed: a sharp mind, good learning ability and creative thinking.

rules.name: Mercury dignified

label.ja: 飲み込みの早さ

rules.reading: Mercury is exalted or in its own sign: quick learning, clear analysis and strong communication.

rules.name: Mercury debilitated

label.ja: 計画的に学ぶと伸びる

rules.reading: Mercury is debilitated: learning works best with structure, repetition and hands-on practice rather than cramming.

rules.name: Rahu in the 12th house

label.ja: 海外への引き寄せ

rules.reading: Rahu in the 12th: interest in foreign lands and possible settlement or work abroad.

rules.name: 12th lord in 9th or 12th

label.ja: 旅行や海外生活に追い風

rules.reading: The 12th lord sits in the 9th or 12th: long-distance travel and time abroad are supported.

rules.name: 4th lord in 1st or 4th

label.ja: 故郷への強い結びつき

rules.reading: The 4th lord sits in the 1st or 4th: a strong attachment to home and family; time abroad may feel best when roots stay close.

rules.name: Jupiter mahadasha

label.en: Your Jupiter period: growth and learning
label.ne: तपाईंको बृहस्पति दशा: वृद्धि र सिकाइ
label.ja: 木星期：成長と学び

rules.reading: Jupiter mahadasha: a period of expansion, learning, mentors and growth in wisdom.

rules.name: Saturn mahadasha

label.en: Your Saturn period: patience pays off
label.ne: तपाईंको शनि दशा: धैर्यले फल दिने
label.ja: 土星期：忍耐が実を結ぶ

rules.reading: Saturn mahadasha: a period that rewards patience, structure and consistent hard work.

rules.name: Venus mahadasha

label.en: Your Venus period: love and creativity
label.ne: तपाईंको शुक्र दशा: प्रेम र सिर्जनशीलता
label.ja: 金星期：愛と創造性

rules.reading: Venus mahadasha: a period favouring relationships, creativity, comfort and the arts.

rules.name: Rahu mahadasha

label.ja: ラーフ期：大きな野心

rules.reading: Rahu mahadasha: a period of big ambitions, new technology, foreign links and unconventional choices.

rules.name: Mercury mahadasha

label.en: Your Mercury period: study and skills
label.ne: तपाईंको बुध दशा: अध्ययन र सीप
label.ja: 水星期：学びとスキル

rules.reading: Mercury mahadasha: a period for study, business, writing and building skills.

rules.name: Sun mahadasha

label.ja: 太陽期：評価と認知

rules.reading: Sun mahadasha: a period of visibility, leadership and recognition from authority.

rules.name: Moon mahadasha

label.en: Your Moon period: home and feelings
label.ne: तपाईंको चन्द्र दशा: घर र भावना
label.ja: 月期：家庭と心

rules.reading: Moon mahadasha: a period centred on home, family, emotions and public connection.

rules.name: Mars mahadasha

label.en: Your Mars period: energy and action
label.ne: तपाईंको मंगल दशा: ऊर्जा र कर्म
label.ja: 火星期：エネルギーと行動

rules.reading: Mars mahadasha: a period of energy, courage, competition and decisive action.

rules.name: Ketu mahadasha

label.ja: ケートゥ期：内省

rules.reading: Ketu mahadasha: a period of introspection, specialised skills and letting go of what no longer fits.
